segment_text: SECTION 8.14. Amendments. No provisions of this Agreement shall be deemed waived, amended, supplemented or modified by any Party hereto, unless such waiver, amendment, supplement or modification is in writing and signed by the authorized representative of each Party.
span_text: No provisions of this Agreement shall be deemed waived, amended, supplemented or modified by any Party hereto, unless such waiver, amendment, supplement or modification is in writing and signed by the authorized representative of each Party.
annotator_notes: Carve-out recorded verbatim per section 8.2: 'unless such waiver, amendment, supplement or modification is in writing and signed by the authorized representative of each Party.' As annotated the obligation is deliberately STRONGER than the contract's -- a flat prohibition where the document permits waiver in signed writing. Three judgment calls, reviewer-approved: (1) 'waived, amended, supplemented or modified' read as ONE obligation with a compound near-synonymous action, not 4 chained obligations, so section 2's 4+ exclusion does not fire; only WAIVE exists in the 34-verb taxonomy. (2) span_text includes the unless clause though the fields encode the carve-out-free reading. (3) obligor 'any Party' is generic and will also return UNRESOLVED_PARTY from typecheck(), so this item exercises two gaps at once.
